leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a frequency counter to track element occurrences in an array
Construct a data structure to store elements with their corresponding frequencies
Manipulate the frequency data to identify the most common elements
Apply sorting or selection logic to extract the top K frequent elements
Initialize and configure a function that returns the correct result for given inputs
Integrate all components into a complete solution for the Top K Frequent Elements problem
Control the algorithm's flow to handle edge cases like empty arrays or invalid K values
